{{Short description|Mathematician}}
'''Muhabbat Arapovna Sharapova''' is a mathematician from [[Uzbekistan]].<ref>{{Cite news|title=The maths genius who chose to be a teacher|language=en-GB|work=BBC News|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/av/world-asia-41614470|access-date=2021-04-28}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=O'qituvchilar va murabbiylar kuni munosabati bilan mamlakatimiz ta'lim-tarbiya tizimida alohida o'rnak ko'rsatgan xodimlardan bir guruhini mukofotlash to'g'risida|url=https://lex.uz/docs/-2384009|access-date=2021-04-28|website=lex.uz}}</ref> She has received the title O‘zbekiston Qahramoni ([[Hero of Uzbekistan]]).<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=President awards Hero of Uzbekistan titles |url=http://www.uzbekistan.org.ua/en/news-en/political-news/3219-president-awards-hero-of-uzbekistan-titles.html |access-date=2023-07-03 |website=www.uzbekistan.org.ua}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Sharapova has a page on the Uzbekistani government's Republican Center of Spirituality and Enlightenment (Respublika Ma'naviyat va Ma'rifat Markazi).<ref name=":2" /> According to the page, which provides most of the information for her early life, Sharapova was born in 1949 in [[Shahrisabz]] as one of eight children. Her mother had dreamed of teaching and pushed Sharapova to become a math teacher. In 1971, she graduated from [[Samarkand State University]] and began to teach at a school in [[Qarshi|Karshi]], which became known for its mathematics.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=oyina.uz |title=Muhabbat Sharapova |url=https://oyina.uz/uz/generation/98 |access-date=2023-07-03 |website=Oyina.uz |language=uz}}</ref>

In 2000, Sharapova started teaching mathematics at a specialized boarding school in Karshi, [[Qashqadaryo Region|Kashkadarya region]].<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":2" /> In 2007, she received a national award as an Honored Worker in Public Education.<ref name=":0" /> In 2016, she was made a Hero of Uzbekistan. According to the Uzbekistani embassy in Ukraine, this award is given to honor "significant achievements before the state and the people."<ref name=":1" />

==Recognition==
Sharapova was recognized as one of the BBC's 100 Women of 2017, which called her "one of the best mathematicians in Uzbekistan."<ref>{{Cite news |date=2017-09-27 |title=BBC 100 Women 2017: Who is on the list? |language=en-GB |work=BBC News |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-41380265 |access-date=2022-12-17}}</ref>
